title: How a Godly Man Wins the Morning Before His Phone Gets a Vote
caption:
The first ten minutes of your day decide more than you think.

Whoever you reach for first when you wake up is who's actually running you. Not in a dramatic way. In the quiet, boring way that adds up to a whole life spent reacting instead of choosing.

A godly man doesn't win the morning by being more disciplined than everyone else. He wins it by deciding the night before where his phone sleeps, and what gets his eyes first.

Start with one room it doesn't enter. Build from there.
